routes.name: Regular admission · qualifying GPA
routes.eligibility: Academic criterion: GPA 4.0/5.0. This fee-paying offer step can precede a separate funding application.

ENGLISH.detail: Qualifying IELTS or equivalent TOEFL required.

IELTS.detail: 6.0 overall; writing 6.0; other sections 5.5. In-person IELTS or equivalent TOEFL.

TOEFL.detail: Equivalent to IELTS thresholds; official scores required, valid on 1 August 2027.

UNT.detail: Not required when qualifying through the GPA criterion.

SAT.detail: Not required on this GPA route.

ACT.detail: Not required on this GPA route.

NUET.detail: A separate financial-support category; not this regular academic criterion.

routes.nextAction: Check transcript conversion for the GPA criterion, then prepare English evidence.

routes.name: NUET · financial-support competition
routes.eligibility: First obtain a regular admission offer. Then submit separate financial-support application and pay for NUET. Minimum NUET: 120 total; 50 each in Mathematics and Critical Thinking & Problem Solving.

ENGLISH.detail: Qualifying IELTS or equivalent TOEFL required.

IELTS.detail: 6.0 overall; writing 6.0; other sections 5.5. In-person IELTS or equivalent TOEFL.

TOEFL.detail: Equivalent to IELTS thresholds; official scores required, valid on 1 August 2027.

UNT.detail: Qualifying regular GPA route can satisfy the offer prerequisite without UNT.

SAT.detail: Qualifying GPA → regular offer → NUET does not require SAT.

NUET.detail: 120 total; at least 50 in each of Mathematics and Critical Thinking & Problem Solving. Eligibility threshold, not an award guarantee.

routes.nextAction: Start with the regular GPA admission route; check English submission and funding deadlines.

routes.name: SAT / ACT · financial-support category
routes.eligibility: Regular admission offer first. Digital SAT 1240 or ACT 26 can satisfy its academic step and the separate SAT/ACT financial-support category. Minimum scores do not guarantee selection.

ENGLISH.detail: Qualifying IELTS or equivalent TOEFL required.

IELTS.detail: 6.0 overall; writing 6.0; other sections 5.5. In-person IELTS or equivalent TOEFL.

TOEFL.detail: Equivalent to IELTS thresholds; official scores required, valid on 1 August 2027.

SAT.detail: Digital SAT 1240 OR ACT 26, not both.

routes.nextAction: Check score reporting and the SAT/ACT financial-support deadline.

routes.name: Foundation · regular admission via GPA
routes.eligibility: GPA 3.5/5.0 is one academic route. Final-year status or completed school required; progression to a degree adds time and depends on foundation results.

IELTS.detail: 5.5 overall; writing/reading 5.5; listening/speaking 5.0, or TOEFL equivalent.

awards.name: NU financial-support competition
awards.benefits: Competitive support; the checked intake criteria do not establish the complete benefits package here. Do not assume living support.
awards.eligibility: Regular offer plus category-specific criteria and English evidence. Minima are eligibility thresholds.
awards.application: Separate application in the NU portal. NUET applicants choose test city and pay the test fee. Accepting the regular offer causes the support application not to be considered.
awards.upfront: Application and test fees may arise before an award decision.
